subject: 63 km this week. Let's build
caption: Build week 2: five runs and a 19 km long run.
motivation: Nothing heroic needed. Stack easy days and let Saturday do the work.
goal: Building to 80 km a week by December
message: This week: 63 km over five runs, with a 19 km long run on Saturday.
Strides on Wednesday, strength on Monday, everything else easy.
Nothing heroic needed. Stack easy days and let the long run do the work.
Every easy km builds toward 80 km a week and Brighton in 3:30.
